description: A large, leafy tree, seen from below, rises through the center of the composition. Clusters of leaves appear in various shades, from bright white to dark gray. Thin, delicate lines surrounding the tree could denote other flora in the work's background. A purplish water stain fills the right edge of the image.
title: Untitled (Tree)
